handbook-papermakingpapyrus:papyrusmakin:
Papyrus making
Papyrus sheets are made by cutting, soaking, layering, and pressing papyrus pith.

Hold papyrus tops in your active hand and a knife in your offhand, then hold rightmouse to cut the pith into strips. Seal the dry strips with water in a barrel to make soaked papyrus strips.

Place 8 soaked strips on the ground, then add 2 boards and a stone to press them. Leave the pile until the papyrus is ready.

Collect the finished sheet with an empty hand.
